question: When writing a composition titled “All About Me”, what should you write first?
options: Your name and how old you are
The name of your favorite television show
answer: Your name and how old you are

question: What can you share about your likes when writing “All About Me”?
options: Your favorite food, color, or game
The price of groceries at the market
How to fix a broken bicycle
answer: Your favorite food, color, or game

question: What is a good ending sentence for “All About Me”?
options: I am happy to be me!
Once upon a time, there was a king.
answer: I am happy to be me!

question: When writing about “A Special Friend”, what should you tell the reader first?
options: What you ate for dinner last night
How many rooms are in your school

question: Which word describes a good and special friend?
What can you write about what you do with your special friend?
options: Games you play together and how you help each other
How to bake a chocolate cake from scratch
The names of all the planets in space
answer: Games you play together and how you help each other

question: Why do we call someone a “special friend”?
options: Because they care about us and make us happy
Because we never talk to them at school
Because they always take our pencils without asking
answer: Because they care about us and make us happy

question: What is the composition “My Summer Holiday” mainly about?
options: Fun places you visited and things you did during the school break
What you do every morning before assembly
How plants grow from tiny seeds
answer: Fun places you visited and things you did during the school break

question: Which sentence belongs in a story about “My Summer Holiday”?
options: During the holiday, I visited my grandparents and swam in the pool.
Every Monday, we wear our clean school uniforms.
A triangle has three straight sides.
answer: During the holiday, I visited my grandparents and swam in the pool.

question: When writing about “My Summer Holiday”, how should you write about things that already happened?
options: In the past tense, like “I went” and “I played”
In the future tense, like “I will go tomorrow”
As a list of spelling words
answer: In the past tense, like “I went” and “I played”

question: Which of these is a fun holiday activity you can write about?
options: Going to the beach, park, or zoo with family
Doing a long math exam in the classroom
Waiting at the bus stop in the rain
answer: Going to the beach, park, or zoo with family

question: What is a good ending sentence for “My Summer Holiday”?
options: It was the best holiday ever and I had so much fun!
Next week we will learn about farm animals.
My pencil is sharp and ready to write.
answer: It was the best holiday ever and I had so much fun!

options: A piece of writing that uses rhythm and rhymes to share feelings or ideas
A list of numbers used for counting

answer: A piece of writing that uses rhythm and rhymes to share feelings or ideas

How does a poem often sound when you read it aloud?
options: Like a song with a nice beat
answer: Like a song with a nice beat

What is a couplet?
options: Two lines of a poem that usually rhyme
answer: Two lines of a poem that usually rhyme

question: How many lines make a couplet?
Which of these is an example of a couplet?
options: I see a little fat cat, / Sitting right on my mat.
The sun is very bright today. / I like to go to school.
Apples are red and sweet. / Bananas are yellow.
answer: I see a little fat cat, / Sitting right on my mat.

question: Why do poets use couplets in poems?
options: To make the poem fun and easy to remember
To make the poem very hard to read
To hide the words on the page
answer: To make the poem fun and easy to remember
